developments.summary: Canada's scheduled 15%, 25% and 50% counter-tariffs took effect; the broader threatened U.S. escalation remains non-operative.
developments.note: The tariff effective time was 12:01 a.m. EDT; Reuters' post-boundary publication independently confirmed implementation at 4:03 a.m. UTC.

developments.summary: Added FDA outbreak-specific data and AP's measured inspection, staffing and response chronology without assigning unsupported outbreak causation.
developments.note: AP published the evidence review after the prior research boundary; the FDA's August 27 figures are restored under their actual measurement date.

developments.summary: DOE financially closed a loan of up to $1.9 billion for the Duane Arnold restart while NRC approval and operation remain pending.
developments.note: A financing close is recorded separately from disbursement, licensing, construction and operating outcomes.

developments.summary: Added OFAC's implemented September 8 aviation-sector designations, license suspension and wind-down authorizations.
developments.note: The update attributes underlying conduct allegations and does not infer blocked assets, grounded flights or diplomatic success.

developments.summary: Corrected AP's fifth-vessel attribution to September 7 and added SOUTHCOM's separate board-transfer-sink operation that day.
developments.note: The September 5 operation remains documented by its primary release; the correction is visible in release metadata.

developments.summary: Recorded the expiration of the capital-specific pause and renewed Kyiv attacks after the U.S. envoys departed.
developments.note: The update treats resumed attacks as an effectiveness finding, not proof that diplomacy cannot later produce an agreement.

developments.summary: Added the public direction to GSA and USTR, without claiming procurement removals are implemented.
developments.note: Source inspection and content review timestamps are recorded separately from the coverage cutoff. Historical versions remain in prior immutable evidence packs.

developments.summary: Added the D.C. Circuit affirmance of preliminary relief against the IRS data-exchange procedure.
developments.note: Source inspection and content review timestamps are recorded separately from the coverage cutoff. Historical versions remain in prior immutable evidence packs.

developments.summary: Updated the same SAVE litigation record with a pending Supreme Court stay application and reported response deadline; restored the filing as a prior-window omission.
developments.note: Source inspection and content review timestamps are recorded separately from the coverage cutoff. Historical versions remain in prior immutable evidence packs.

developments.summary: Updated the existing support-pressure record with announced year-end retirement and Bunch’s denial of a pressure-caused departure.
developments.note: Source inspection and content review timestamps are recorded separately from the coverage cutoff. Historical versions remain in prior immutable evidence packs.

developments.summary: Added the signed veterans order with 30-, 120- and 180-day implementation deadlines; no completed system or measured effect is claimed.
developments.note: The action date is known as September 8; exact signature time was not published, so the evidence cutoff is used as the development bound.

developments.summary: Added independently confirmed disclosure reporting $155,000 in personal gifts to four White House aides, without alleging a proven legal violation.
developments.note: The AP publication time bounds public availability. Underlying disclosure forms were reported by three outlets but were not directly available in the inspected archive.

developments.summary: Added the signed Defense Production Act delegation change; no project-specific allocation, contract or expenditure is inferred.
developments.note: The action date is known as September 8; exact signature time was not published, so the evidence cutoff is used as the development bound.

developments.summary: Added five signed Canadian-product proclamations with September 15 and 29 effective dates, preserving product-level scope and non-implementation at cutoff.
developments.note: The AP publication time bounds public confirmation; the official instruments are dated September 8 and future-effective.

developments.summary: Restored the prior-window omission of five additional U.S.-announced tanker strikes and the attributed Iranian retaliation, with unresolved damage and legal questions.
developments.note: Reuters publication predates the prior coverage boundary; the omission is restored under its actual September 8 date rather than misdated as a new event.

developments.summary: Added the federal investigation of the fatal Miami cargo overrun with preliminary recorder evidence and no probable-cause inference.
developments.note: The record preserves the actual event date and lifecycle state; publication timing is separately reflected in the research window and repository history.

developments.summary: Added TSA's implemented, limited gateside-access program at 13 airports without inferring national access or measured outcomes.
developments.note: The record preserves the actual event date and lifecycle state; publication timing is separately reflected in the research window and repository history.

developments.summary: Restored the September 8 Ahmed jurisdictional dismissal with its five-business-day appeal protection and unresolved merits.
developments.note: The record preserves the actual event date and lifecycle state; publication timing is separately reflected in the research window and repository history.

developments.summary: Added the later U.S. and Jordanian missile assessments, unresolved merchant-vessel incidents and Brent's move above $100.
developments.note: The record preserves the actual event date and lifecycle state; publication timing is separately reflected in the research window and repository history.

developments.summary: Added NHTSA's final child-restraint rule with delayed compliance dates, school-bus exemptions and projected costs and benefits.
developments.note: The Federal Register publication establishes the final rule; later effective and compliance dates and measured outcomes remain distinct lifecycle stages.

developments.summary: Restored CDC's September 4 effective respiratory-disease reorganization from its September 9 publication without inferring staffing or performance effects.
developments.note: The record uses the actual September 4 effective date and separately preserves the September 9 public-document date.

developments.summary: Added DOE's formal implementation inquiry for the bulk-power emergency without treating it as a product determination or removal order.
developments.note: The RFI is a later implementation stage within the existing emergency record.

developments.summary: Added DHS's effective interim rule expanding the foreign-government-employee category while preserving the class injunction and unresolved merits.
developments.note: The September 9 publication documents a rule effective September 4; the existing order's injunction remains a separate lifecycle state.

developments.summary: Added the two-part Census Bureau proposal without treating it as a changed 2030 census, a lawful final rule or a measured apportionment outcome.
developments.note: The primary proposal was filed before the prior cutoff but was restored transparently once independently reported and fully inspected.

developments.summary: Added the signed Los Tiguerones designations and announced Ecuador assistance while preserving publication, funding and delivery lifecycle limits.
developments.note: The legal notices are separated from later effectiveness and from the independently reported assistance announcement.

developments.summary: Added two multistate lawsuits as allegations at filing, with no complaint-text inspection, merits ruling, injunction or change to the challenged rules.
developments.note: This is a later litigation stage within the existing regulatory record.
